summary: The proposed change failed Prelight's safety thresholds.

steps.description: Prevent global deployment of the proposed configuration.
Investigate the measured latency regression and determine its cause.
Repeat the experiment with additional runs to confirm the regression is reproducible.
Evaluate a smaller configuration change between the baseline and rejected candidate.
Run the new candidate through the complete Prelight validation pipeline.

rollout_policy: No production rollout until a subsequent validation run satisfies the configured Prelight safety thresholds.
